actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The phase monster attacks with its horns and its claws.

actions.name: Horns
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage. If the target is a creature and the phase monster moves at least 20 feet straight towards the target before the attack  the target takes an additional 5 (2d4) bludgeoning damage and makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw  falling prone on a failure.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc:
Forma: True Form Only.
Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage  plus an additional 5 (2d4) slashing damage if the target is prone.

actions.name: Blood-Curdling Scream
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The phase monster unleashes a horrific screech. Each creature within 60 feet that can hear it makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is frightened for 1 minute. While frightened by Blood-Curdling Scream  a creature must take the Dash action and move away from the phase monster by the safest available route on each of its turns  unless there is nowhere to move. If the creature ends its turn in a location where it doesnt have line of sight to the phase monster  the creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a successful save  it is no longer frightened.

bonus_actions.name: Shapeshift
bonus_actions.desc: The phase monster magically changes its form to that of a Small goat or into its true form. While in goat form, it loses its fly speed and Mirror Image trait. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged in each form.

special_abilities.name: Mirror Image
special_abilities.desc: A magical illusion cloaks the phase monster, creating a reflection of the monster nearby and concealing its precise location. While the monster is not incapacitated, attack rolls against it have disadvantage. When a creature hits the phase monster with an attack, this trait stops working until the end of the phase monsters next turn.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6+2) piercing damage and the target makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw  taking 14 (4d6) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success. If the poison damage reduces the target to 0 hit points  the target is made stable but poisoned for 1 hour  even if it regains hit points  and it is paralyzed while poisoned in this way.

bonus_actions.name: Ethereal Jaunt
bonus_actions.desc: The spider magically shifts from the Material Plane to the Ethereal Plane or vice versa.

special_abilities.name: Ethereal Sight
special_abilities.desc: The spider can see into both the Material Plane and Ethereal Plane.

special_abilities.name: Spider Climb
special_abilities.desc: The spider can climb even on difficult surfaces and upside down on ceilings.

special_abilities.name: Web Walker
special_abilities.desc: The spider ignores movement restrictions imposed by webs.

actions.name: Pierce
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit  one target directly underneath the piercer. Hit: 10 (3d6) piercing damage. This attack has disadvantage against a creature that is protecting its head with a shield or similar object. If the attack misses  the piercer dies.

special_abilities.name: False Appearance
special_abilities.desc: While motionless, the piercer is indistinguishable from a normal stalactite.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.desc: Ranged Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d8) piercing damage.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bandit captain attacks twice with their scimitar and once with their dagger or throws two daggers.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) slashing damage.

actions.name: Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 feet  one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.desc: If the bandit captain is wielding a melee weapon and can see their attacker, they add 2 to their AC against one melee attack that would hit them.

special_abilities.name: Seawise
special_abilities.desc: Pirate captains have an expertise die (1d4) on skill checks made to handle or navigate a ship.

a5e-mm_pit-fiend.name: Pit Fiend
a5e-mm_pit-fiend.damage_resistances: cold; damage from nonmagical, non-silvered weapons

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The pit fiend attacks with its bite and mace.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) piercing damage. If the target is a creature  it makes a DC 20 Constitution saving throw. On a failure  it is poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way  the target can't regain hit points and takes 21 (6d6) ongoing poison damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat this saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) bludgeoning damage plus 21 (6d6) fire damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it makes a DC 22 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pushed 15 feet away from the pit fiend and knocked prone.

actions.name: Circle of Fire
actions.desc:
1/día.
A 15-foot-tall  1-foot-thick  20-foot-diameter ring of fire appears around the pit fiend  with the pit fiend at the center. The fire is opaque to every creature except the pit fiend. When the ring of fire appears  each creature it intersects makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw  taking 22 (5d8) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a successful one. A creature takes 22 (5d8) damage the first time each turn it enters the area or when it ends its turn there. The fire lasts 1 minute or until the pit fiend dismisses it  becomes incapacitated  or leaves its area.

actions.name: Fireball
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; V, S) Fire streaks from the pit fiend to a point within 120 feet and explodes in a 20-foot radius  spreading around corners. Each creature in the area makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw  taking 21 (6d6) fire damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Hold Monster
actions.desc: (5th-Level; V, S, Concentration) A creature within 60 feet that the pit fiend can see makes a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is paralyzed for 1 minute. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Claw
bonus_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (2d10 + 8) slashing damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 22). While the target is grappled, the pit fiend can't use its claw against a different creature.

bonus_actions.name: Tail
bonus_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 24 (3d10 + 8) bludgeoning damage.

special_abilities.name: Fear Aura
special_abilities.desc: A creature hostile to the pit fiend that starts its turn within 20 feet of it makes a DC 18 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened until the start of its next turn. On a success, it is immune to this pit fiends Fear Aura for 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The pit fiends spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 18). It can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:

- **At Will:** Detect Magic, Fireball
- **3/Day Each:** Hold Monster, Sending

actions.name: The targets head takes on the appearance of a beasts head (donkey, wolf, etc)
actions.desc: The targets statistics dont change  but the target can no longer speak; it can only make animal noises.

actions.name: Thorn Dagger
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 10/30 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage.

actions.name: Faerie Blessing
actions.desc:
3/día.
The pixie targets a willing creature within 30 feet. The target gains one of the following abilities for 1 hour:

actions.name: The target gains truesight out to a range of 120 feet
The target gains the benefit of the pixies Magic Resistance trait
Faerie Curse
actions.desc: The pixie targets a creature within 30 feet not already under a Faerie Curse. The target makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  the target is subjected to a special magical curse for 1 hour. The curse ends if the pixie dies or is incapacitated  the pixie or one of its allies deals damage to the target  or the pixie spends an action to end the curse. Spells such as remove curse  dispel magic  and lesser restoration also end the curse. If a creature makes its saving throw or the condition ends for it  it is immune to any Faerie Curse for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: When the target fails its saving throw against this effect, the pixie chooses one of the following effects to impose on the target
The target is charmed by the pixie
If the target is already charmed by the pixie, the target falls asleep
actions.desc: It wakes if it is shaken awake as an action or if it takes damage.

bonus_actions.name: Invisibility
bonus_actions.desc: The pixie and any equipment it wears or carries magically turns invisible until the pixie attacks, casts a spell, becomes incapacitated, or uses a bonus action to become visible.

special_abilities.name: Faerie Light
special_abilities.desc: As a bonus action, the pixie can cast dim light for 30 feet, or extinguish its glow.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance
special_abilities.desc: The pixie has advantage on saving throws against spells and magical effects.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The planetar attacks twice with its flaming sword.

actions.name: Flaming Sword
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) slashing damage plus 21 (6d6) ongoing fire or radiant damage (the planetars choice). A creature can use an action to extinguish this holy flame on itself or a creature within 5 feet.

actions.name: Heavenly Bolt
actions.desc: The planetar fires a lightning bolt in a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw  taking 56 (16d6) lightning damage on a failed save  or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Heal
actions.desc:
2/día.
The planetar touches a creature other than itself  magically healing 60 hit points of damage and ending any blindness  curse  deafness  disease  or poison on the target.

bonus_actions.name: Awe-Inspiring Gaze
bonus_actions.desc: The planetar targets a creature within 90 feet. The target makes a DC 20 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is frightened until the end of its next turn. If the target makes its saving throw, it is immune to any angels Awe-Inspiring Gaze for the next 24 hours.

reactions.name: Protective Parry
reactions.desc: When a creature within 5 feet would be hit with a melee attack, the planetar applies disadvantage to the attack roll.

special_abilities.name: Champion of Truth
special_abilities.desc: The planetar automatically detects lies. Additionally, it cannot lie.

special_abilities.name: Innate Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The planetars spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell save DC 20). The planetar can innately cast the following spells, requiring no material components:
- **1/Day Each:** Commune, Control Weather, Raise Dead

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) piercing damage. The target makes a DC 14 Strength saving throw. On a failure  it is pulled up to 5 feet towards the plesiosaurus.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: The plesiosaurus can hold its breath for 1 hour.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1 piercing damage and the target makes a DC 10 Constitution saving throw  taking 5 (2d4) poison damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The bear makes two melee attacks.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d8+5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Claws
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 7 (1d4+5) slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature  it is grappled (escape DC 15). Until this grapple ends  the bear can't attack a different target with its claws.

special_abilities.name: Keen Smell
special_abilities.desc: The bear has advantage on Perception checks that rely on smell.

actions.name: Hooves
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +2 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 2 (1d4) bludgeoning damage.

actions.name: Mace
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) bludgeoning damage. On a hit  the priest can expend a spell slot to deal 7 (2d6) radiant damage  plus an extra 3 (1d6) radiant damage for each level of the spell slot expended above 1st.

actions.name: Sacred Flame
actions.desc: (Cantrip; V, S) One creature the priest can see within 60 feet makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw  taking 9 (2d8) radiant damage on a failure. This spell ignores cover.

actions.name: Guiding Bolt
actions.desc: (1st-Level; V, S) Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 14 (4d6) radiant damage  and the next attack roll made against the target before the end of the priests next turn has advantage.

actions.name: Dispel Magic
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; V, S) The priest scours the magic from one creature  object  or magical effect within 120 feet that they can see. A spell ends if it was cast with a 3rd-level or lower spell slot. For spells using a 4th-level or higher spell slot  the priest makes a Wisdom ability check (DC 10 + the spells level) for each one  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Spirit Guardians
actions.desc: (3rd-Level; V, S, M, Concentration) Spectral forms surround the priest in a 10-foot radius for 10 minutes. The priest can choose creatures they can see to be unaffected by the spell. Other creatures treat the area as difficult terrain  and when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there  it makes a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw  taking 10 (3d6) radiant or necrotic damage (priests choice) on a failure or half damage on a success.

bonus_actions.name: Healing Word
bonus_actions.desc: (1st-Level; V) The priest or a living creature within 60 feet regains 5 (1d4 + 3) hit points. The priest can't cast this spell and a 1st-level or higher spell on the same turn.

special_abilities.name: Spellcasting
special_abilities.desc:
The priest is a 5th level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Wisdom (spell save DC 13 +5to hit with spell attacks). They have the following cleric spells prepared:

- **Cantrips** (at will): Light, Sacred Flame, Thaumaturgy
- **1st-Level** (4 slots): Ceremony, Detect Evil and Good, Guiding Bolt, Healing Word
- **2nd-Level** (3 slots): Lesser Restoration, Zone of Truth
- **3rd-Level** (2 slots): Dispel Magic, Spirit Guardians

special_abilities.name: Flyby
special_abilities.desc: The pteranodon doesnt provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of a creatures reach.

actions.name: Multiattack

actions.name: Fists

bonus_actions.name: Haymaker
bonus_actions.desc:
1/día.
The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the attack deals an extra 7 (2d6) damage.

bonus_actions.name: Head Shot
bonus_actions.desc:
1/día.
The pugilist attacks with their fists. On a hit, the target makes a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, it is stunned until the end of the pugilists next turn.

special_abilities.name: Unarmored Defense

a5e-mm_purple-worm.name: Purple Worm
a5e-mm_purple-worm.senses: blindsight 30 ft., tremorsense 60 ft., passive Perception 15

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The worm attacks two different targets with its bite and its tail stinger.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 25 (3d10 + 9) piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature  it makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure  the target is swallowed. A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained  it has total cover from attacks from outside the worm  and it takes 24 (7d6) acid damage at the start of each of the worms turns.

actions.name: If a swallowed creature deals 35 or more damage to the worm in a single turn, or if the worm dies, the worm vomits up all swallowed creatures
Tail Stinger
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw  taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

reactions.name: Fighting Retreat
reactions.desc: When a creature makes an opportunity attack on the worm, the worm attacks with either its bite or its tail stinger.

special_abilities.name: Tunneler
special_abilities.desc: The worm can tunnel through earth and solid rock, leaving behind a 10-foot-diameter tunnel.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: The hydra bites once with each of its heads.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 15 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) piercing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
If the pyrohydra has at least 4 heads  it breathes fire in all directions. Each creature within 30 feet makes a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw  taking 59 (17d6) fire damage on a failure or half damage on a success.

legendary_actions.name: The hydra can take 2 legendary actions
legendary_actions.desc: Only one legendary action can be used at a time and only at the end of another creatures turn. It regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.

legendary_actions.name: Rush
legendary_actions.desc: The hydra moves or swims up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks. If this movement would pass through the space of creatures that are not incapacitated or prone, each creature makes a DC 17 Strength saving throw. On a failure, the creature is knocked prone and the hydra can enter its space without treating it as difficult terrain. On a success, the hydra can't enter the creatures space, and the hydras movement ends. If this movement ends while the hydra is sharing a space with a creature, the creature is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space.

legendary_actions.name: Wrap
legendary_actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one Medium or smaller creature. Hit: The target is grappled (escape DC 17) and restrained until this grappled ends. The hydra can grapple one creature for each of its heads. When one of the hydras heads is killed while it is grappling a creature, the creature that killed the head can choose one creature to free from the grapple.

special_abilities.name: Hold Breath
special_abilities.desc: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.

special_abilities.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
special_abilities.desc: When the hydra fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead. When it does so, its heads lose coordination. It is rattled until the end of its next turn.

special_abilities.name: Multiple Heads
special_abilities.desc: While the hydra has more than one head, it has advantage on Perception checks and on saving throws against being blinded, charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, and knocked unconscious, and it can't be flanked.

special_abilities.name: Reactive Heads
special_abilities.desc: For each head it has, the hydra can take one reaction per round, but not more than one per turn.

special_abilities.name: Regenerating Heads
special_abilities.desc: The hydra has seven heads. Whenever the hydra takes 30 or more damage in one turn, one of its heads dies. If all of its heads die, the hydra dies. At the end of its turn, it grows 2 heads for each head that was killed since its last turn, unless it has taken at least 20 cold damage since its last turn.

special_abilities.name: Toxic Secretions
special_abilities.desc: Water within 1 mile of the hydras lair is poisoned. A creature other than the hydra that is immersed in the water or drinks the water makes a DC 17 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature is poisoned for 24 hours. On a success, the creature is immune to this poison for 24 hours.

special_abilities.name: Wakeful
special_abilities.desc: When some of the hydras heads are asleep, others are awake.

actions.name: Claws (Bite While Shapeshifted)

Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 11 Constitution saving throw  becoming poisoned for 1 minute on a failure. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success.

actions.name: Scare
actions.desc:
Forma: Quasit Form Only.
A creature within 20 feet that can see the quasit makes a DC 11 Wisdom saving throw. On a failure  it is frightened for 1 minute. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns  ending the effect on a success. If a creature makes its saving throw or the condition ends for it  it is immune to any quasits Scare for the next 24 hours.

actions.name: Shapeshift
actions.desc: The quasit magically changes its form into a bat (speed 10 ft.  fly 40 ft.)  centipede (40 ft.  climb 40 ft.)  or toad (40 ft.  swim 40 ft.)  or back into its true form. Its statistics are the same in each form except for its movement speeds. Equipment it is carrying is not transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

bonus_actions.name: Invisibility
bonus_actions.desc: The quasit magically turns invisible, along with any equipment it carries. This invisibility ends if the quasit makes an attack, falls unconscious, or dismisses the effect.

special_abilities.name: Chaotic Evil
special_abilities.desc: The quasit radiates a Chaotic and Evil aura.

special_abilities.name: Magic Resistance

actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 19 (3d6 + 9) piercing damage  and the target makes a DC 19 Constitution saving throw  taking 42 (12d6) poison damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

reactions.name: Fighting Retreat
reactions.desc: When a creature makes an opportunity attack on the worm, the worm attacks with either its bite or its tail stinger.

special_abilities.name: Sand Cascade
special_abilities.desc: When the worm emerges from under sand, each creature within 30 feet makes a DC 24 Constitution saving throw, falling prone on a failure.

special_abilities.name: Tunneler
special_abilities.desc: The worm can tunnel through earth and solid rock, leaving behind a 10-foot-diameter tunnel.

a5e-mm_sapphire-dragon-wyrmling.languages: Deep Speech, Draconic, Undercommon, telepathy 120 ft.

actions.name: Bite
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (3d10 + 3) piercing damage.

actions.name: Discognitive Breath
actions.desc:
Recarga: 5.
The dragon unleashes psychic energy in a 15-foot cone. Each creature in that area makes a DC 12 Intelligence saving throw  taking 22 (4d10) psychic damage on a failed save or half damage on a success.

special_abilities.name: Far Thoughts
special_abilities.desc: The dragon is aware of any creature that uses a psionic ability or communicates telepathically within 100 miles of it. As an action, the dragon can psionically observe a creature, object, or location it is familiar with within 100 miles. While observing a subject in this way, the dragon can see, hear, and communicate telepathically, but it is blind and deaf in regard to its physical senses and does not require food or water. The dragon can psionically observe a subject indefinitely and can end this effect and return to its own senses as an action.
